description: This file defines the 'XUnit' struct, a value object representing a measurement and its unit of measure (points, inches, millimeters, centimeters, presentation units) within the PDFsharp library. It provides constructors, properties, conversions, and operator overloads for handling measurement units in PDF rendering contexts.

classes.name: XUnit
classes.description: Represents a value and its unit of measure, providing conversions and formatting for measurement units used in PDF rendering.
